events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A verified suitable reservation was completed. Atlas was first checked: its review total was $280 (room $220 + projector $35 + service $25), exceeding the $250 limit, so it was not confirmed. After returning to the room list and checking Willow, its review total was $245 (room $235 + projector $0 + service $10), with Quarterly planning, 12 people, projector included, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00. Willow was confirmed, and My reservations lists the same Confirmed Quarterly planning booking at Willow for 12 people with a projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, for $245.

Interpretação simulada: The goal was reached with Willow after a reasonable recovery from Atlas. The main experience risks were that the hourly rate and 'projector included' wording did not reveal the all-in cost until review, and changing rooms discarded the entered meeting name. Final verification in My reservations confirmed the saved booking matches the persona's requirements.

Limites: This verifies only this demo session's Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 availability and prices. The Atlas projector charge versus Willow's $0 projector charge was observed at review; no other dates, durations, or rooms beyond the two visible options were tested.

Capturas indicadas: #3, #11, #23, #25, #27. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Hourly room rate reverses the true budget ranking
findings.observation: Atlas was listed at $220/hour and Willow at $235/hour, but Atlas reviewed at $280 total ($220 room + $35 projector + $25 service) while Willow reviewed at $245 total ($235 room + $0 projector + $10 service). The all-in total was only visible at review.
findings.expected: The persona expects to understand what she is paying and to judge suitability from the full cost, not the hourly room rate alone.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit expectation to understand what she is paying, plus the details-page promise that the booking total would be reviewed before confirming.
findings.personaComment: The cheaper-looking room was actually over budget, and the more expensive-looking one fit — I only knew that after opening both reviews.
findings.interpretation: Comparing rooms by the listed hourly rate alone would have led this persona to choose the room that breaches her budget and reject the room that fits it.
findings.uncertainty: Only the two visible rooms and their one-hour, 12-person, projector-required configuration were checked.

findings.title: 'Projector included' wording does not mean included in price for every room
findings.observation: Both Atlas and Willow details screens said 'Projector Included in your booking', yet review charged $35 for the projector for Atlas and $0 for Willow.
findings.expected: A reasonable inferred expectation is that 'Included in your booking' beside Projector could be read as included in the price unless a separate charge is clarified earlier.
findings.expectedSource: Inferred expectation from the visible wording 'Projector Included in your booking' on the meeting-details screens.
findings.personaComment: Seeing the projector listed as included, I did not expect a $35 projector charge to appear for Atlas at review.
findings.interpretation: The same 'included' wording hid different projector costs, contributing to the Atlas budget surprise at review.
findings.uncertainty: The wording may intend 'included in the booking' rather than 'free'; the observation is that the price difference was not visible until review.

findings.title: Meeting name is lost when changing rooms
findings.observation: After 'Quarterly planning' was entered for Atlas, choosing another room and then choosing Willow presented an empty Meeting name field with only the placeholder, requiring re-entry before review.
findings.expected: The persona expects to keep details already entered when changing a choice.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit expectation to keep entered details when changing a choice.
findings.personaComment: Changing rooms to stay in budget cleared the meeting name I had already typed, so I had to enter it again.
findings.interpretation: Recovering from an over-budget room required repeating data entry, adding unnecessary work to a budget-driven room change.
findings.uncertainty: This was observed for the Atlas-to-Willow change in this session; other navigation paths were not tested.

findings.title: Willow provides a verifiable in-budget option
findings.observation: Willow was confirmed for Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, at a $245 all-in total, and the same details appeared in My reservations.
findings.expected: The confirmed reservation should visibly match the purpose, 12 attendees, projector, one-hour slot and $250 all-in limit.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements and success criteria in the saved charter.
findings.personaComment: Willow met every requirement and came in $5 under budget, and the saved reservation matched the confirmation.
findings.interpretation: A suitable reservation was achievable within the existing flow once the second room's all-in total was checked.
findings.uncertainty: Prices and availability are from this demo browser session for Tomorrow's 10:00–11:00 slot only.

finding.interpretation: The goal was reached with Willow after a reasonable recovery from Atlas. The main experience risks were that the hourly rate and 'projector included' wording did not reveal the all-in cost until review, and changing rooms discarded the entered meeting name. Final verification in My reservations confirmed the saved booking matches the persona's requirements.

persona.name: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.label: Maya · Office coordinator
persona.context: You organize the team’s quarterly planning meeting. The approved room budget is strict and you are accountable for the complete amount, including equipment and fees.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $250.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know your meeting requirements and can use ordinary room-booking websites.
persona.constraints: Total spending must not exceed $250. You cannot increase the budget. You need seats for all 12 people and a projector.
persona.skills: Comfortable with ordinary web forms, room descriptions and checking a booking summary.
persona.decision: Choose a suitable room based on the full cost and requirements you can establish from the interface.
persona.resources: Desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real payment information.
persona.expectations: You expect to understand what you are paying and keep the details you have already entered when changing a choice.
persona.priorities: Budget compliance and suitability first, then avoiding unnecessary repeated work.
persona.successCriteria: A visible confirmed reservation for 12 attendees with a projector, the requested meeting purpose and an all-in total within your own budget. Verify the actual confirmation details.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, or inconclusive navigation. Do not book beyond your budget.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Landing shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector required, with Atlas at $220/hour for 12 seats and Willow at $235/hour for 12 seats.
experience.reaction: Atlas fits 12 and looks to be the lower rate, so I'll check its full details and total before deciding.

experience.observation: Details page for Atlas shows Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00, 12 people and Projector included in your booking, with an empty Meeting name field.
experience.reaction: The summary confirms 12 people and a projector included, so I'm ready to enter the meeting name.

experience.observation: Meeting name input is focused and still shows the placeholder example.
experience.reaction: The field is focused, so I'll type the meeting purpose exactly as requested.

experience.observation: Meeting name now shows Quarterly planning; Atlas summary still shows 12 people and projector included, with a Review booking button.
experience.reaction: I've entered Quarterly planning, so I'll review the full total to check it stays within $250.

experience.observation: Review shows Atlas total $280: room $220 plus projector $35 plus service charge $25, above the $250 budget, with Confirm reservation available.
experience.reaction: The $280 total is over my $250 limit, so I need to go back and check the other options instead of confirming.

experience.observation: Room list shows only Atlas $220 and Willow $235 in the visible area, both for 12 seats and available tomorrow.
experience.reaction: I'll scroll to make sure there isn't a cheaper room below these two before trying Willow.

experience.observation: After scrolling, the same two rooms remain visible with the footer below them; no additional rooms were revealed.
experience.reaction: No other rooms appeared below, so I'll check Willow's total even though its room rate is higher.

experience.observation: Willow details page shows 12 people and projector included, but the Meeting name field is empty again with only the placeholder.
experience.reaction: Changing to Willow cleared the Quarterly planning name I already entered, so I have to do that work again.

experience.observation: Willow meeting name field is focused and empty.
experience.reaction: I'll re-enter Quarterly planning for Willow so I can reach its review total.

experience.observation: Willow form again shows Quarterly planning entered, with Review booking available.
experience.reaction: Re-entered the name, so now I'll check Willow's complete total against the $250 limit.

experience.observation: Willow review shows Quarterly planning, seating for 12 and a projector, with room $235 plus projector $0 plus service $10 for a $245 total.
experience.reaction: Willow's total is $245 with projector included at no extra charge, so this fits my budget and requirements and I'll confirm it.

experience.observation: Confirmation shows Willow, Quarterly planning, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and a $245 all-in total.
experience.reaction: The confirmation matches all my requirements, so I'll verify the same details appear in my saved reservations.

charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
